g.text: Animations in and out of Vizij
Blender, and any other glTF tool

text.tspan: Editing the baked animation in Blender
and re-exporting is NOT a supported route.
Blender's exporter drops every extension, so its
output has no bundle, no records and no RobotData.
Preserving them would need a Blender-specific
add-on, which we have chosen not to build.
Measured against Blender 5.2.1. A save writes each clip twice: losslessly into VIZIJ_bundle, which is the source of truth, and baked into
glTF channels so other tools can play the motion. The bake is one way by design. The animation-only import still works for any glTF
animation from any tool -- it lands as import-new, a new clip beside the existing ones -- it just is not a round trip Vizij designs for.
baked, so any tool can play it
lossless clips, the source of truth
import as a new clip alongside

g.text: one way: to be seen, not brought back
